name: pnp-copilot-pro-dev-da-threews-3d-studio
title: three.ws 3D Studio declarative agent
shortDescription: Declarative agent for Microsoft 365 Copilot that finds free 3D models and 3D agents on three.ws, lists your own agents and generates a textured GLB from a description.
longDescription: This sample adds a declarative agent to Microsoft 365 Copilot with one API plugin (API key authentication). Users search a catalog of free CC0 models, find public three.ws agents, list the agents they own and generate a textured 3D model (GLB) from a plain-language prompt. Every answer is an Adaptive Card with an Open in 3D viewer link.
